The complete hidden-file inventory under agent contains no CODEOWNERS at any location and no required-review rules or branch-protection IaC. The sole .github file is ci.yaml, whose pull_request trigger runs tests without defining required reviewers. This is the explicit no-CODEOWNERS failure specified by the check; the cited trigger is supporting context for the missing control, not itself a prohibition on reviews. External settings cannot be verified.

CI builds and attests main images with commit and digest records, and the deployment pins a digest. Kyverno requires main CI signatures and provenance. However, no production deployment workflow or deploy authorization configuration is present, so deployment exclusively through CI and approval of main cannot be established.

A complete hidden-file inventory and searches for branch protection, rulesets, force pushes and required reviews found no source-branch protection configuration. Selecting main as a workflow trigger does not block force pushes or deletion; external repository settings are unavailable.
